actions.item: Water budget optimizer accepts genuine loss-making crop economics
actions.before: Optimizer refused negative gross margins, hiding a real agricultural loss-making enterprise from client planning data
actions.change: Allow bounded signed gross margins per hectare while preserving nonnegative area and water and excluding loss-making crops from optimal allocations
actions.after: Calculator implementation and three regression cases committed; CI water calculator 18 tests passed; not a commercial service or customer delivery
